attack_paths.scenario_title: Query injection reads data and bypasses login
attack_paths.description: Request-controlled text reaches SQL, NoSQL and XML parsers unescaped, letting callers alter queries, bypass login and read stored data.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Committed signing key allows forged logins
attack_paths.description: Weak or exposed credential handling lets attackers forge or guess login tokens and take over accounts without valid credentials.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Missing ownership and role checks expose records
attack_paths.description: Missing object-level and role checks let ordinary or anonymous callers read, change or administer resources they do not own.

attack_paths.scenario_title: File and key disclosure via traversal and SSRF
attack_paths.description: Unvalidated paths and URLs let callers read or write files outside intended locations and fetch internal resources.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Profile input executed as server code
attack_paths.description: User-supplied text is evaluated as code on the server, giving attackers control over the application process.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Script injection steals stored session tokens
attack_paths.description: Unsafe HTML rendering combined with script-readable token storage lets injected scripts steal a visitor's session.
